verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents creating, acknowledging and resolving incidents directly from Slack, with events synced to its dashboard. It also posts a todo list when an incident triggers and routes it to a responder. Nothing shows automatic incident-channel creation, role assignment, or declaring and running incidents from Teams, which appears only as a notification channel and an AI SRE entry point. Missing for 10: auto-created incident channels, incident role assignment (e.g. commander), automated stakeholder updates from chat, incident declaration from MS Teams, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can declare and run an incident from chat — Slack or Teams — with channels, roles, and updates created for me

citations.quote: Create, acknowledge and resolve incidents directly from Slack. We automatically sync all events between Slack and the Better Stack dashboard.
Post a todo list when a new incident is triggered. Route the incident to the right responder.
The incident alert message includes information about the monitor, as well as the options to acknowledge the incident or to view more details in Uptime.
